content.text: Oracle Cites ‘Force Majeure’ to Shield Itself on Controversial Data Center: Citing people familiar with the matter, Bloomberg reported that Oracle sent a force-majeure notice to the Project Jupiter developer, a Blue Owl unit, and was seeking payment relief if the campus did not come online as planned in 2028 rather than seeking to exit as tenant. The updated version added that the notice alone did not establish a delay and that any rent deferral depended on agreement about a power-related force-majeure event; the notice itself was not published. (time=2026-09-24T12:25:00Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
